rationale: The held texts support the substance: EO 2489 (ProQuest text, Wilson, 21 November 1916) reserves only the NE1/4 sec. 21, T. 28 S., R. 8 W., N.M.P.M., and EO 8376 (5 FR 1077 and the APP mirror, signed 13 March 1940) paragraph 2 revokes it by number. Both basis spans and all source hashes match the held bytes, and the number search finds no earlier ending. But the proposed interval is wrong: it gives start 1913-11-21 and end 1937-03-13, when the held sources show 1916-11-21 and 1940-03-13. The interval also contradicts the decision's own rationale, which gives 1916 and 1940, so the proposal cannot be accepted even though NO is the right status.
